_om: Fireren in English (Fourby, rusj.no/en/fourby/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen legger litt hulter til bulter. F: The phone plays a bit all over the place. Good for little ones.
Mobilen ser noen trekk fram. Passe utfor: The phone looks a few moves ahead. A fair challenge.
Mobilen tenker dypt. Klarer du å slå den: The phone thinks hard. Can you beat it?
Du får fire på rad!: You get four in a row!
Mobilen får fire på rad!: The phone gets four in a row!
Brettet er fullt. Uavgjort!: The board is full. It's a draw!
Brettet er fullt – uavgjort!: The board is full – it's a draw!
Du vinner! Fire på rad!: You win! Four in a row!
Du vinner kampen – først til {n}!: You win the match – first to {n}!
Slipp brikkene ned i brettet. Den som fø: Drop the discs into the board. The first to get four in a row wins the round.
Trykk på en kolonne. Brikka faller ned t: Tap a column. The disc falls to the lowest free space.
Få fire brikker etter hverandre – bortov: Get four discs in a line – across, up or diagonally.
Har den andre tre på rad med en ledig pl: Has the other player got three in a row with a free space? Put your disc there before it's too late!
Midten er gull: Den midterste kolonnen e: The middle is gold: the centre column is part of the most possible lines.
Først til 3: Den som først vinner tre ru: First to 3: whoever wins three rounds first wins the match. Choose ‘No end’ if you just want to keep playing.
Lag to trusler samtidig, så klarer ikke: Make two threats at once, and your opponent can't block both.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar tilbake brikka: Tapped the wrong column? ‘Undo’ takes the disc back.
First to four in a row wins.
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Du har de rosa brikkene. Du og mobilen b: You have the pink discs. You and the phone take turns to start.
Spiller 1 har rosa, spiller 2 gul. Dere: Player 1 is pink, player 2 is yellow. You take turns to start.
Den som først vinner {n} runder, vinner: Whoever wins {n} rounds first wins the match.
Dere spiller så mange runder dere vil, o: Play as many rounds as you like, and stop whenever you like.
Godt kjempa! Prøv igjen – du blir bedre: Well fought! Try again – you get better every round.
Like mange seirer hver. Det får avgjøres: The same number of wins each. It'll have to be settled next time!
Vent litt – mobilen tenker: Hang on – the phone is thinking
Dere går til kåringen. Stillingen er {st: You'll go to the results. The score is {stilling}.
You can always start a new one.
